resources.string: Draw from one sentence, or edit a picture already in the workspace; one confirmation card each time, uses Gemini quota

Draw with Gemini\'s image models (a confirmation card pops up before each run; the model is picked live from your key\'s available list — Nano Banana Pro first, then Nano Banana 2, with no fallback to older models): text-to-image from one sentence, or image-to-image using a picture in the workspace as reference. Output stays on this device only — the default workspace writes to 资料库/整理/, a custom workspace to 产物/, and an existing name is never overwritten. Images are not uploaded anywhere else. Uses your Gemini quota, up to 4 images per run. Without a key, or if the key has no image model, it tells you exactly where to fix it.
